changelog: - **One "Connected calendars" card, with connection health** (#1993). The Google-only card is replaced by a provider-shaped `ConnectedCalendarsCard` fed by a new `GET /api/integrations/calendar/status`, which reads `session.user.id` and returns one row per entry in the new `src/lib/calendarProviders.ts` registry (Google is the only entry until #1991) through an explicit column allowlist — never a token, never another user's row. Each row renders three distinct states: not configured by the operator (no dead button), configured but not connected, and connected — the latter showing the account e-mail, a relative "last synced" label and, when `lastError` is set, a warning strip with the provider's own message and a Reconnect button. `lastError` and `lastSyncAt` were already stored and nothing on screen read them, so a revoked token read as "connected" while meetings quietly stopped syncing.

en: Your account settings now show a "Connected calendars" card that tells you which calendar account is connected, when it last synced, and warns you with a Reconnect button when the connection has stopped working.
tr: Hesap ayarlarında artık "Bağlı takvimler" kartı var: hangi takvim hesabının bağlı olduğunu, en son ne zaman eşitlendiğini gösteriyor ve bağlantı çalışmayı bıraktığında "Yeniden bağlan" düğmesiyle seni uyarıyor.
de: In den Kontoeinstellungen gibt es jetzt die Karte "Verbundene Kalender": Sie zeigt, welches Kalenderkonto verbunden ist und wann zuletzt synchronisiert wurde — und warnt mit einer Schaltfläche "Erneut verbinden", sobald die Verbindung nicht mehr funktioniert.
